description: This file defines message structures and classes for inter-process communication within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes classes for framing, input/output messages, initialization, setup, and IPC message types, along with utility functions and constants.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a fixed-size data frame used for message serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Encapsulates input message data, including implementation ID, interface ID, and method ID.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Encapsulates output message data, including implementation ID, interface ID, method ID, and mode flags.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents initialization message with various types such as acquire, offer, revoke, and request.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup configuration data for the messaging system, including implementation, sequence number, and categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts various incoming types to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32-bit and 64-bit systems.

methods.name: Frame::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes frame data into a byte stream starting from a given offset.

methods.name: Frame::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte stream into the frame starting from a given offset.

methods.name: Input::Set
methods.description: Sets the implementation ID, interface ID, and method ID into the input frame.

methods.name: Input::Implementation
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation ID from the input data.

methods.name: Input::InterfaceId
methods.description: Retrieves the interface ID from the input data.

methods.name: Input::MethodId
methods.description: Retrieves the method ID from the input data.

methods.name: Output::AddImplementation
methods.description: Adds implementation details and mode flags to the output data.

methods.name: Init::Set
methods.description: Initializes the message with various parameters including class name, implementation, interface ID, exchange ID, and type.

methods.name: Init::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the init message data is valid.

methods.name: Setup::Set
methods.description: Sets up the configuration with implementation, sequence number, proxy stub path, messaging, and warning categories.
